about: Animated look (how-to card): the frog eaten in the first hour of the day.

scenes.narration: Do your hardest, most important task first.

lines: the big task you keep putting off

scenes.narration: Brian Tracy calls it your frog. It's the big, unpleasant task you're most likely to put off, and the one that would make the biggest difference.

params.title: Eat it first
params.summary: Then the rest of the day is easier

scenes.narration: His advice: eat it first, before easier work fills the day. Get it done early, and the dread is gone. The momentum carries into everything else.
And if you have two frogs? Start with the uglier one.
Clearing email and small chores first feels productive. But usually, it just delays the work that actually matters.
Tonight, choose tomorrow's frog. Then start it first thing, before you check your messages.
